question: 40% of the employees in a factory are workers. All the remaining employees are executives. The annual income of each worker is 390rs. The annual income of each executive is Rs. 420. What is the average annual income of all the employees in the factory together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Workers = 40%, Executives = 60%

Use weighted average directly

Average income = (390 × 40 + 420 × 60) ÷ 100

⇒ (15600 + 25200) ÷ 100

⇒ 408

**∴ The correct answer is ₹408.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Workers = 40%

Executives = 60%

Income of each worker = ₹390

Income of each executive = ₹420

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average = (x₁w₁ + x₂w₂) ÷ (w₁ + w₂)

 40% Workers ₹390 60% Executives ₹420 Average = ₹408 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Assume total employees = 100

⇒ Workers = 40, Executives = 60

⇒ Total income of workers = 40 × 390 = ₹15600

⇒ Total income of executives = 60 × 420 = ₹25200

⇒ Total income = 15600 + 25200 = ₹40800

⇒ Average income = 40800 ÷ 100

⇒ = ₹408

**∴ The correct answer is ₹408.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When groups have different sizes, average = Total Value ÷ Total Number.

Alligation Method

For two groups, average can also be found using alligation ratios.

Percentage to Quantity

Assuming total population as 100 often simplifies percentage-based average questions.

Combined Average

Combined Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total observations).
